claims.text: Works well and is highly recommended for thick, coarse, or natural hair.
Durable and long-lasting compared to other brands, with sturdy teeth that don't break off.
Fits some dryers well (e.g., BaByliss) but may not fit others without modification.
Can slip or fall off the dryer nozzle if not tightened enough.
Some units broke or melted, including a metal rod breaking and a ring melting.

qa.q: Will this nozzle fit my blow dryer?
qa.answer: It depends on your dryer: reviews report it fits a BaBylissPRO Nano Titanium Dryer [3] but did not fit Revlon or Conair dryers [1][4], and one reviewer got it onto a Conair Infiniti only with a workaround [5].

claims.text: It fits a BaBylissPRO Nano Titanium Dryer perfectly.
It did not fit Revlon or Conair blow dryers.
One reviewer made it work on a Conair Infiniti only by unscrewing the ring and wrapping grip material around the dryer.

qa.q: Is it durable enough to handle high heat?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on heat durability: some report it melting or burning within minutes [3][6], while others describe it as unbreakable or still going strong after 18 months [2][5].

claims.text: One reviewer reports the ring melted about 5 minutes into blow drying [6].
Another reviewer reports it got so hot it burned skin and broke into pieces [3].
Other reviewers describe it as unbreakable or still going strong after 18 months [2][5].

qa.q: Does it stay comfortable to hold during use?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: Is it safe to use on my hair and scalp?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on safety: one reviewer reports the attachment got so hot it burned their skin and their hairdresser said it "fried" their hair [1], while other reviewers describe using it successfully for blow-dry results and over 7 years without reporting harm [3][5][6].
